lines: There was one day, when Shiva himself... broke.
There was one day when Shiva himself broke.
Her father, King Daksha, despised him.
Daksha held a great fire ceremony, and invited every god.
Her father mocked Shiva, before them all.
Her father mocked Shiva before them all.
she gave her life, to the sacred fire.
she gave her life to the sacred fire.
He lifted her in his arms...
He lifted her in his arms,
and walked. Across the whole world.
and walked across the whole world.
And when the storm was spent...
And when the storm was spent,
Even Shiva, had to sit with his pain.
Even Shiva had to sit with his pain.
